name: adplane
description:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to Claude so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane subscription. A 14 day free trial starts when you sign up, no card required.

_published_faq.name: How do I add adplane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add adplane to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.adplane.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the adplane MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: adplane lists 27 MCP tools, including google_add_keywords, google_add_negative_keywords, google_create_ad, google_create_ad_group, google_create_campaign, google_get_report_schema, google_list_accounts, google_remove_campaign, google_run_gaql, google_run_report, google_update_object, and meta_check_readiness.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to adplane?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to adplane in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
adplane requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
adplane is developed by Adplane. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
